SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
Harbour Digestive Centre (fictional)
Gastroscopy and Colonoscopy Procedure Note
Date of service: 2026-10-29
Endoscopist: Synthetic Endoscopist, MD (fictional)
Sedation: propofol by a CRNA (fictional)
UPPER ENDOSCOPY
The gastroscope was advanced to the second part of the duodenum. Cold forceps biopsies were taken from the gastric
antrum.
LOWER ENDOSCOPY FINDINGS
The colonoscope was advanced to the cecum. A 7 mm sessile polyp in the sigmoid colon was removed with a cold snare.
A prophylactic clip was placed at the polypectomy site.
Impression: antral biopsies; one sigmoid polyp removed.
